newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks jump 2.01 pct on June trade surplus.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks jump 2.01 pct on June trade surplus.

text.p: The Seoul stock market shot up by 2.01 percent in Tuesday's afternoon trading on the news that South Korea in June had posted its first monthly trade surplus since December 1994, brokers said.
The composite stock index gained 15.01 points to 760.41 at 0525 GMT.
LG Electronics hit a 1997 high of 17,800 won in early afternoon trading on active foreign buying interest.
Tuesday's largest trading volume was seen in Daewoo Electronics with 1.06 million shares changing hands. It went limit up, gaining 540 won to 7,390.
Hwang said the news that customer deposits at brokerage houses exceeded margin loans by 100 billion won also improved investors' sentiment.
